steps.note: arrival: the Rustflat Front is live and its Foreman is on the field, read from the encounter's own state
the Foreman's health before the shots, kept for the arrival comparison
click the field to capture the pointer, the same gesture the game asks for; it also fires the first aimed shot
a measured turn off the wreck. Scrap projects no entity screen point, so aimAt has nothing to aim at yet; look is the only aim step with a real crosshair behind it
control shot with the crosshair off the Foreman: reported, not asserted, because a moving target can wander into it
the same measured turn back onto the wreck, so the crosshair sits where the Foreman stands
arrival: the Foreman lost health to fire aimed at it - a hit landed, judged by the game's own stat and not by the keypress
the before and after health prints beside the step so the drop is a number, not a claim
